title: Account Assistant
description:
As an Account Assistant in Southampton within the leisure, travel and tourism industry, you'll play a key role in supporting the accounting and finance team with day-to-day tasks. Your work will help ensure financial processes run smoothly and accurately, contributing to the overall efficiency of the business.

Client Details

A company based in Southampton operating in the leisure, travel and tourism industry.

Description
- Process invoices and manage accounts payable and receivable activities.
- Assist with reconciliations and ensure accuracy in financial records.
- Support the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Maintain and update financial data in the accounting system.
- Handle queries related to financial transactions and accounts.
- Collaborate with the finance team to meet deadlines and objectives.
- Assist with month-end and year-end financial tasks.
- Ensure compliance with internal accounting policies and procedures.

Profile

A successful Account Assistant should have:
- Previous experience in an accounting or finance role.
- A good understanding of financial processes and systems.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Good organisational skills to manage tasks effectively.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.

Job Offer
- A salary ranging from £30,000 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- A permanent position in the leisure, travel and tourism industry.
- Opportunities to develop your skills within a professional accounting and finance team.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant

Southampton

A great opportunity has become available for a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join a well-established law firm at its Park Gate office in Southampton. Working as part of a busy and friendly Commercial Property team, you will provide essential day-to-day legal and administrative support to Fee Earners across a varied commercial property caseload.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting Fee Earners with a varied commercial property caseload.
- Liaising with clients and third parties, including estate agents, landlords and other solicitors.
- Opening new files and matters on the firm's Case Management system.
- Drafting correspondence, documents and precedents on behalf of Fee Earners.
- Completing ID checks for clients.
- Providing general administrative and legal support to the Property team as required.

You will ideally have:
- At least 2 years plus legal secretarial or legal assistant experience within Property.
- Experience supporting commercial property matters.
- Strong legal administration and secretarial skills.
- Experience with audio typing and digital dictation systems.
- Previous experience using a Case Management system.

What they Offer:
- Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm and in the office.
- Salary depending on experience - £26,000 - £28,000
- 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays. Increasing by 1 day per year after 5 years' service (not exceeding 30 days)
- Pension scheme.
- Discounted legal services after one year service.
- Discounted gym membership relating to the Health Cash Plan.

title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller in Southampton, you'll play a key role in managing the accounts receivable process for the retail industry. Your work will help ensure the smooth running of the company's finances by maintaining healthy cash flow and reducing outstanding debts.

Client Details

A company in the retail industry based in Southampton.

Description
- Manage customer accounts and monitor outstanding balances.
- Chase overdue payments via phone, email, or written correspondence.
- Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly.
- Prepare and distribute account statements and reports.
- Maintain accurate records of all credit control activities.
- Liaise with internal teams to resolve invoice queries.
- Assist with setting and monitoring credit limits for customers.
- Support month-end reporting and compliance processes.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Experience in credit control or a similar accounting role.
- Knowledge of financial processes and procedures.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confidence in communicating with customers and internal teams.
- Proficiency in using financial software and Excel.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and debt management.

Job Offer
- Salary of £30,000 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Permanent position with opportunities to develop skills in the retail industry.
- Located in Southampton for ease of access.

title: Laboratory Administrator / Archivist (Data Co-ordinator)
company: DEKRA Organisational & Process Safety - Agency - Contract
description:
Laboratory Administrator / Archivist (Data Co-ordinator)

Location: Site Based, Southampton, SO16 7 NS
Contract: Up to 12 months FTC maternity cover
Salary: £12.71 per hour

Do you want to boost the future towards a safe, secure and sustainable world

At DEKRA we deal with future topics in every field of work: from vehicle inspection to cyber security, from product testing to clean energies or from automated driving to artificial intelligence.

We anticipate technical developments early on and drive industry transformation as thought leaders.

For the exciting tasks that lie ahead we are looking for skilled and passionate people who want to grow and achieve their best in a global team.

Enthusiasts wanting to do meaningful work and to make a contribution as a trusted partner for our clients and for society. People like you.

A Day in the Life and the Impact You'll Make

As a Data Co-ordinator, you'll play an important role in supporting our Laboratories team, helping to keep projects organised, samples accurately recorded and technical reports delivered on time.

From booking in samples and preparing study files to maintaining laboratory records and managing archives, you'll work across a varied role where accuracy, organisation and attention to detail really matter.

What You'll Do
- Manage the archive room, ensuring records are stored correctly and maintained in line with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP).
- Coordinate the booking-in and unboxing of samples, maintaining accurate sample records and databases.
- Prepare GLP and non-GLP technical reports for our Industrial Explosive Hazards, Regulatory Testing and Electrostatic laboratories.
- Maintain the Laboratories Master Schedule and Globex system.
- Liaise with clients regarding sample and test programme queries.
- Support project administration, including sales orders, consumables and financial information.
- Coordinate the return or destruction of study data and reports at the end of the archiving period.
- Support reception duties when required.
- Work collaboratively across DEKRA to identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and customer service.
- Work with laboratory teams to ensure test results and reports are delivered promptly.
- Maintain high standards of health, safety, data protection and information security.

What You'll Bring
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Good IT skills and confidence using technology and databases.
- Excellent organisation skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- GCSEs in Science and English, or equivalent.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- A positive, proactive approach and willingness to support colleagues.
- A strong team ethic and commitment to delivering excellent customer service.

What Success Looks Like
- Well-maintained laboratory records and archives.
- Accurate and timely sample booking-in and unboxing.
- High-quality technical reports delivered within agreed timescales.
- KPIs achieved across sample receipt, booking-in, reporting and archiving.
- Clear, professional communication with internal and external customers.

Why DEKRA

At DEKRA, our people make the difference. We value Responsibility for Safety, Entrepreneurship, Customer Orientation, Integrity and Team Spirit.

We encourage our people to be proactive, share ideas, solve problems and continuously look for better ways of working. Development within DEKRA will depend on business needs, as well as your ability, ambition and drive.

Let's create a safer world today. Apply now and join a team that values your expertise and passion.

At DEKRA we value your unique experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We are committed to an inclusive workplace for all team members.

title: Administrator
description: University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us. Job Title: Administrator Contract Type: Permanent/Fixed Term Please see below for detailed job description of the role. This is an exciting opportunity to join our team. Looking to start your career in the NHS? We are recruiting for full-time and part time across a variety of entry-level positions within our Trust. Our hospitals rely on a dedicated team of administrators, and these roles are key to keeping our services running smoothly. You will play an important part in supporting both patients and clinical teams, helping to ensure a positive and seamless patient experience. Wherever you join us, our values of Patients First, Working Together and Always Improving will guide everything you do. While we are a large university hospital, we pride ourselves on our commitment to continuous improvement and the genuine compassion we show to every patient. We offer a wide range of career pathways within administration, making this an excellent opportunity to build your experience within the NHS. You will benefit from comprehensive training and development, giving you the support and skills needed to grow and progress in your career. Secondment opportunities will also be considered for internal applicants who are looking to broaden their experience across different roles or areas of the hospital The successful candidate will be responsible for undertaking a variety of administrative duties within a role aligned to their skills and experience. Placements may be available across University Hospital Southampton, Princess Anne Hospital or Royal South Hants Hospital. The responsibilities of these roles include, but are not limited to, the following: Outpatient Administrator Centre - The Outpatient Administrator Centre is at the hub of outpatient administration within the Trust. It is a busy, interesting and often diverse department where we provide support to the clinical outpatient services and excellent customer service to patients. Receptionist - You will be the face of the Trust and responsible meeting and greeting our patients and their relatives in a friendly and knowledgeable manner. You may also be responsible for registering of patients on to the hospital computer systems and ensuring all patients personal matters / records are dealt with in a confidential manner. Ward Administrator You will be working on a ward(s) providing administrative support such as managing patient notes, relieving clinical staff of general administrative duties, answering the phone and meeting and greeting patients and relatives Booking Administrator - the role will provide excellent customer service to patients, relatives/carers and to external agencies andyou will build good working relationship with the Consultants, the rest of the administrative team and nursing staff. Emergency Care Administrator within the Emergency Care Unit here at University Hospital Southampton. The department is in operation 24/7 - 365 days and the roles entail a variety of shifts over each 4-week period including early shifts, late shift, long days, twilights (if the candidate drives and does not rely on public transport) plus nights. They will also be rostered for bank holidays and Christmas one year, and the next year New Year. WHAT YOULL DO To provide an excellent customer service to patients, relatives/carers and to external agencies Ensure a consistent and effective administrative service is maintained at all times Build relationships with stakeholders externally and internally WHAT WERE LOOKING FOR You will: Have experience of working in a customer services environment Have a friendly and approachable manner Be polite, sympathetic and diplomatic and have a can-do attitude Provide excellent customer service to patients, relatives/carers and to external agencies, this will include communication that is face to face, over the telephone and through written correspondence Provide comprehensive administration services and have high standards of accuracy and attention to detail High standards of accuracy with attention to detail Ability to communicate over the telephone and in person Competent IT skills, including a working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages The ability to work independently but also be a good team player The hospital offers a 24 hour service, however for these roles you could be scheduled onto shifts between the hours of 7am and 10pm Monday to Sunday so will require good flexibility around your working hours. If you are looking for part time employment, please note we would need you to work a minimum of 15 hours per week. There are roles across the Trust, including in care groups such as Women and Newborn, Neurosciences and more. Please indicate in your application if there is an area that you would be particularly interested in.
